cadenceDecision.explanation: Three weekly publications require three cyclic gaps averaging 56 hours; the required 72-hour minimum requires at least 216 hours across a complete three-publication cycle. No publication cadence is approved until the owner selects a feasible mode.

spacingPolicy.explanation: Two long-form videos followed by one Short repeat in a rolling cycle. Each consecutive actual publication must be at least 72 elapsed hours apart, so a complete three-gap cycle requires at least 216 hours. No weekly publication count is promised.

publicationCycle.description: Rolling three-publication sequence: long-form, long-form, Short. Each next actual publication waits at least 72 elapsed hours from the prior actual publication; the earliest full cycle is 216 hours (9 days), not a weekly target.
